mergeReason: 17 sheets form 15 themes by merging A+team07 classic and C+team05 fractured; earliest reference is an additional classic source.

themes.title: 클린 키캡
themes.style: ivory ABS keycaps, charcoal switch housings, orange tracks, lime status lights; crisp clean chunky classic computer castle
themes.background: light cornflower blue sky, gentle jade hills only near bottom, faint distant keyboard towers and airy soft pixel clouds

themes.title: 슬림 키레일
themes.style: slender graphite aluminum key rails, narrow elongated ivory keys, a few orange electrical tracks; vertical industrial precision
themes.background: cool pale blue fog, narrow distant vertical elevator shafts, steel blue atmospheric clouds

themes.title: 파손 키캡
themes.style: fractured ivory PBT keys, broken square fragments, dark chassis reinforcement, orange cables; salvage computer castle but strong structural joints
themes.background: faded blue grey sky, abandoned computer citadel arches, faint hanging disconnected cables at side edges, dusty cloud haze

themes.title: 아이보리 고성
themes.style: warm rough beige limestone castle, narrow uncolored Gothic lancet niches, broad stone cornices, no gilding, no blue enamel
themes.background: warm luminous ivory arcade silhouettes, pale golden sky, soft warm cloud banks, quiet distant medieval towers

themes.title: 자주빛 폐성
themes.style: weathered charcoal-purple rubble stone castle, chipped purple blocks, deep Gothic recesses, crumbly old masonry, no large metal clamps
themes.background: ashy lavender sky and fog, ruined pointed window silhouettes and jagged ruined castle spires, desaturated mauve clouds

themes.title: 주홍 벽돌
themes.style: large bright vermilion brick battlements, thick slate-grey mortar, big chunky rectangular bricks, simple square stone reinforcement
themes.background: pale apricot sky, big distant red brick crenellated silhouettes and chimney shapes, soft cream clouds

themes.title: 청회색 석성
themes.style: cool blue grey granite fortress, broad irregular rectangular stone blocks with blocky cracks, dark navy narrow supports, no key symbols
themes.background: overcast blue grey clouds, faint distant granite ramparts and slit windows, cool mist layers

themes.title: 앤티크 전산성
themes.style: aged beige keyboard keys in walnut-brown iron frame, dull amber indicators, burnt orange insulated wires, not gears; antique terminal castle
themes.background: sepia amber clouded sky, distant old terminal hall arches and copper pipe silhouettes, dusty warm haze

themes.title: RGB 키보드
themes.style: dark grey large mechanical keycaps, fuchsia and cyan RGB traces, strong square key silhouettes with few plus marks, keyboard castle not server panels
themes.background: midnight navy blue cloud sky, dark distant keyboard silhouettes and circuit board line structures, sparse tiny pink blue point lights

themes.title: 백색 고딕
themes.style: ivory porcelain key cathedral, elegant fluted buttresses, cobalt pointed arch recesses, small antique gold trim and white ceramic keys; repeat BODY MUST have plain matching end sockets without turret caps
themes.background: pale cobalt cloud sky, shadowy low saturation blue cathedral arches, ivory towers in distant mist and tiny gold architectural accents

themes.title: 흑요석 요새
themes.style: massive angular charcoal-violet obsidian blocks, broad iron clamp bands, sharp fortress teeth, recessed square switch seats and restrained amethyst details, clean hard large facets not crumbly rubble
themes.background: stormy grey purple sky, monumental distant iron gates and brutalist obsidian tower silhouettes in layered mist

themes.title: 적갈 벽돌 보루
themes.style: small staggered burnt terracotta brick courses, iron tie plates and worn reddish copper reinforcement, a few pale ceramic switch insets, stepped corbels; different from large vermilion bricks
themes.background: warm russet mist, distant brickworks and furnace towers without fire, muted dusty peach sky and smoke-like soft clouds

themes.title: 청동 기계
themes.style: verdigris green keys, amber brass rails, large simple cog half-wheels, piston supports and bold rivets in dark chestnut structure; regular mechanical matching joints
themes.background: desaturated teal atmospheric sky, enormous faint distant gear silhouettes and factory arches, soft turquoise and bronze haze

themes.title: 네온 데이터
themes.style: angular midnight server panels, cyan and magenta data buses, horizontal status display slots, broad blank dark screens and magnesium vents; server fortress rather than plus-key column
themes.background: violet blue sky with abstract soft data clouds, distant server rack arches and tiny cyan display slots, low saturation futuristic city haze

themes.title: 유리 회로
themes.style: aqua mint glass keycaps, white enamel rails, dark green PCB plates and square chips, crisp glass facets and sparse copper connectors, hard pixel glass not snow or ice
themes.background: light mint turquoise sky, faint distant glass corridor arcades, translucent geometric towers and soft seafoam clouds
